name: 18368-visionchat-llama4scout-8gpu
model: unsloth/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct -- the ungated mirror of the gated `meta-llama` repo, same architecture and weights: BF16, 50 safetensors shards, 217 GB, not in this machine's cache.
parallelism: TP=8, PP=1, DP=1. One engine, one node.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=32, bounded at 1000 requests with a 900 s safety cap, warmup the first 10% by completion.
workload: `lmarena-ai/VisionArena-Chat`, one image per request, as a local 1000-row copy with columns `prompt` / `images` / `output_tokens_count` (built by the recipe below); 128 output tokens with eos ignored, temperature 0.0. Prompts average ~87 text tokens and images span 600x464 to 1024x768.
purpose: A visual chat assistant answering picture-and-text questions with short replies for 32 concurrent users on one eight-GPU node.
launch:
# Serving config: Llama-4-Scout on ONE 8-GPU node, image+text chat at 32 concurrent streams.

# Ungated mirror of the gated meta-llama repo: same architecture, same 50 shards / 217 GB,
# torch_dtype bfloat16. NOT CACHED -- expect the download.
model: unsloth/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct

tensor-parallel-size: 8

# Load-bearing: the checkpoint's own max_position_embeddings is 10485760, so without this cap
# the engine sizes the KV cache against ten million positions and will not start.
max-model-len: 32768

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

dtype: bfloat16

# Pinned so the scheduler shape cannot drift with the launch path or a future default.
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

# STARTUP BUDGET, not a performance choice. The runner kills any measurement that has completed
# no request within 900 s. On 2026-08-22 the 8-rank engine loaded all 50 shards in 45 s and then
# spent the remaining 11 minutes inside torch.compile of the 109B MoE language model without
# reaching the point where vLLM writes its compile cache, so the run was killed before serving
# anything. Eager execution removes that phase and the engine reaches the first request in
# minutes.
enforce-eager: true
